components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem; font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--color-ink, #2e3a31); text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-mark { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-leaf-tint, #dde9d0); color: var(--color-leaf, #2f6b4f); } .ds-brand-mark svg { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-brand-mark { animation: ds-drift 3s ease-in-out infinite; } } @keyframes ds-drift { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-3deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(3deg); } } .ds-links { margin-left: auto; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 1.25rem; } .ds-links a { font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-muted, #5e6b61); text-decoration: none; } .ds-links a:hover, .ds-links a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--color-ink, #2e3a31); } .ds-email { max-width: 16rem; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-muted, #5e6b61); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(46 58 49 / 0.08); }

narrative.overview:
Butterfly Net is a garden where thoughts land. The ground is a warm off-white. Piles are soft pastel patches, like flower beds. Each card is a white chip resting on its patch. One deep leaf green marks what's alive and actionable: the Catch and Save buttons, the butterfly, focus. Everything is rounded, from Nunito's letterforms to pill buttons and patch corners. The garden should feel friendly and lived-in, never busy.

The system is light and nearly flat. Depth comes from colour, white chips on pastel patches on the ground, with only a breath of shadow to lift a chip or float the capture box. Motion is limited to the butterfly drifting gently in the header and colour easing in the preview. Copy speaks in the same voice ("What's fluttering around?", "Nothing here yet. Nice and quiet."), so words and shapes carry the warmth together.

It is grown-up playfulness. It is not a productivity dashboard with charts, priority flags, red badges or dense tables. It is not a dark, techy "AI" look with glowing gradients or sparkle icons; Claude's work shows up as a plain sentence in the preview. It is not cartoony either: no mascots and no bouncing.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white ground, one leaf-green accent, six pastel pile colours.
Rounded everything: Nunito type, pill buttons, generously curved patches.
Depth by colour layering (ground → pastel patch → white chip), with whisper-soft shadows.
Heavy type weights (700–800) at modest sizes; friendly rather than loud.
Cards age like paper: cream, then yellow, then deep yellow, with a small age label.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Leaf Green is the only saturated colour and it always means "act here" or "this worked". Pastels decorate; they never mark an action.

rules.name: The Pastels Are Places Rule
rules.body: A pile colour belongs to a pile. Don't use pastels as generic decoration, status colours or highlights.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Nunito only. Build hierarchy from weight (500/600/700/800) and the 0.875–1.25rem range. Don't add a display face or go under 0.875rem.

rules.name: The Medium Placeholder Rule
rules.body: Placeholders drop to weight 500 in Moss Grey, so they never look like typed text.

rules.name: The Float Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Only the capture box and transient toasts float. Piles never cast shadows; they lie flat on the ground.

dos: Do keep Leaf Green (`#2f6b4f`) for actions and success only, per the One Green Rule.
Do build depth by layering Garden Ground → pastel → Petal White before reaching for a shadow, and use only the Chip and Float shadows.
Do round everything: pills for buttons and badges, 1rem for chips and fields, 1.5rem for patches, 1.75rem for the capture surface.
Do keep tap targets at least 44px and keep Moss Grey (`#5e6b61`) as the lightest text colour on the ground, to meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
Do give empty and waiting states a warm line of copy and, at most, a small butterfly.
Do wrap decorative motion in `motion-safe` and keep it slow and small (3s, 4px).
donts: Don't add dashboard furniture: charts, priority flags, red notification badges, progress rings or dense tables.
Don't style Claude as "AI magic": no glowing gradients, sparkle icons, purple-blue shimmer or dark techy panels. Claude appears as a plain sentence in the preview.
Don't go cartoony: no mascots, no bouncy or springy animation, no illustrations beyond the single-stroke butterfly.
Don't add a second typeface or set text below 0.875rem.
Don't use pile pastels for anything except piles, or saturate them.
Don't add dark shadows, hard corners or boxed hairline borders around piles.
